# gsur_denominator_source.txt
# Provenance for lfst_r_lfp2acedu_FR_YEAR.tsv and lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_YEAR.tsv (2014, 2015, 2016)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Revised: 2026-05-17 (corrected age-band limitation note; removed schema-drift F4 entry)
# Revised: 2026-05-20 (added y2014 and y2015 entries; Assets 3–6)

ASSET 1: lfst_r_lfp2acedu_FR_2016.tsv
PURPOSE: Labour force denominators (economically active population) by NUTS-2 x sex x age x
         education, France 2016. Usable only at BROAD age bands (Y15-74, Y25-64). The narrow
         10-year age bands required by v2.1 spec section 6 are NOT available in this table
         at any NUTS level -- the table is published at broad age bands only.

DATASET: lfst_r_lfp2acedu
TITLE: Economically active population by sex, age, educational attainment level and NUTS 2
       regions (1,000)
SOURCE: Eurostat SDMX-CSV API
URL: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/data/lfst_r_lfp2acedu?format=SDMX-CSV&startPeriod=2016&endPeriod=2016
Downloaded: 2026-05-17
Full download: Data/external/lfst_r_lfp2acedu_2016_full.csv (all countries, 2016)
Filtered to: France metropolitan NUTS-2 codes (22 regions), unit=THS_PER, freq=A, TIME_PERIOD=2016
Saved as: Data/external/lfst_r_lfp2acedu_FR_2016.tsv

AGE BANDS AVAILABLE:
  Y15-74, Y25-64, Y_GE15 ONLY.
  Y15-24, Y25-34, Y35-44, Y45-54, Y55-64 are NOT published in this table at any level.
  This is a structural limitation of the Eurostat publication, not a filter or suppression issue.
  Confirmed by inspecting the full all-countries download: zero rows with narrow age bands.

CELL SUPPRESSION (usable education cells ED0-2, ED3_4, ED5-8, sex M/F):
  21 of 22 regions: zero suppressed cells. Full Y15-74 coverage.
  FRM0 (Corse): all cells flagged u (unreliable). OBS_VALUE present.
  See RURO_GSUR_external_acquisition_completion_v1.md section 6 for full inventory.

USAGE NOTE:
  This file provides D1 denominators (labour_force) for BROAD-AGE cells only.
  Per v2.1 spec section 5, the weighting_source column takes one of three values:
    labour_force, population, approximate_uniform.
  (No fourth value. Unaggregatable cells use the broad-age national value as described
  in spec section 5(D3)(a); they are not a separate weighting_source category.)
  For narrow-age cells, use lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_2016.tsv (population, weighting_source=population).

---

ASSET 2: lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_2016.tsv
PURPOSE: Population denominators for GSUR v2. Primary source for NARROW age-band cells
         (Y15-24, Y25-34, Y35-44, Y45-54, Y55-64) because lfst_r_lfp2acedu does not publish
         these bands. Also used as fallback for FRM0 broad-age cells where lfst_r_lfp2acedu
         is flagged unreliable.

DATASET: lfst_r_lfsd2pop
TITLE: Population in private households by educational attainment level and NUTS 2 region
SOURCE: Eurostat SDMX-CSV API
URL: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/data/lfst_r_lfsd2pop?format=SDMX-CSV&startPeriod=2016&endPeriod=2016
Downloaded: 2026-05-17
Full download: Data/external/lfst_r_lfsd2pop_2016_full.csv (all countries, 2016)
Filtered to: France metropolitan NUTS-2 codes (22 regions), unit=THS_PER, freq=A, TIME_PERIOD=2016
Saved as: Data/external/lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_2016.tsv

AGE BANDS AVAILABLE:
  Y15-24, Y25-34, Y35-44, Y45-54, Y55-64, Y15-74, Y20-64, Y15-64, Y25-64,
  Y_GE15, Y_GE25, Y_GE65.
  All required narrow bands present for all 22 regions.

NARROW-BAND SUPPRESSION (OBS_FLAG=u, education cells ED0-2/ED3_4/ED5-8, sex M/F):
  660 cells total (22 regions x 5 age bands x 2 sex x 3 ISCED).
  56 cells suppressed (8.5%). Affected regions and bands:
    FRC1: Y25-34
    FRC2: Y15-24, Y25-34, Y55-64
    FRD1: Y15-24, Y25-34
    FRE2: Y15-24
    FRF2: Y15-24, Y55-64
    FRI2: all five bands (Limousin -- small region)
    FRI3: Y15-24
    FRK1: Y15-24, Y25-34, Y35-44
    FRM0: all five bands (Corse -- small region)
  Note: suppressed cells carry OBS_FLAG=u; most have OBS_VALUE present (unreliable
  estimate). Cells with missing OBS_VALUE require D3 (approximate_uniform) fallback
  with explicit reviewer sign-off per v2.1 spec section 5(D3).

USAGE NOTE:
  weighting_source = 'population' for all cells using this file.
  Per v2.1 spec section 5(D2), population weighting is an acceptable approximation.
  D1 vs D2 comparison at Y15-74 level must be reported in the Stage A validation report
  (for cells where both are available).
  FRI2 and FRM0 fully-suppressed narrow-age cells: use D3 (approximate_uniform) with
  reviewer sign-off, or broad-age fallback, per O2 resolution decision.

---

ASSET 3: lfst_r_lfp2acedu_FR_2014.tsv
PURPOSE: Labour force denominators (economically active population) by NUTS-2 x sex x age x
         education, France 2014. Diagnostic/D1 source only (same broad-age-band limitation as
         2016 reference; see Asset 1).

DATASET: lfst_r_lfp2acedu
TITLE: Economically active population by sex, age, educational attainment level and NUTS 2
       regions (1,000)
SOURCE: Eurostat SDMX-CSV API
URL: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/data/lfst_r_lfp2acedu?format=SDMX-CSV&startPeriod=2014&endPeriod=2014
Downloaded: 2026-05-20
Full download: Data/external/lfst_r_lfp2acedu_2014_full.csv (all countries, 2014; 19,484 lines)
Filtered to: France metropolitan NUTS-2 codes (22 regions), unit=THS_PER, freq=A, TIME_PERIOD=2014
Saved as: Data/external/lfst_r_lfp2acedu_FR_2014.tsv (988 data rows + 1 header)
Schema: identical to Asset 1 (columns: DATAFLOW, LAST UPDATE, freq, unit, sex, age, isced11,
        geo, TIME_PERIOD, OBS_VALUE, OBS_FLAG, CONF_STATUS; tab-separated)
NUTS vintage: NUTS-2016 codes confirmed (FR10, FRB0, FRC1, ... FRM0 - same 22 as 2016 reference)

AGE BANDS AVAILABLE:
  Y_GE15, Y15-74, Y25-64 ONLY. Same broad-band limitation as 2016.

CELL SUPPRESSION (Y20-64, usable education cells, sex M/F):
  FRM0 all ED cells flagged u (unreliable) - identical pattern to 2016 reference.
  NRP category flagged u across all 21 non-FRM0 regions (same as 2016).
  226 of 988 D1 cells carry OBS_FLAG=u across all age bands.

---

ASSET 4: lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_2014.tsv
PURPOSE: Population denominators for GSUR v2 Stage A, opportunity year 2014. Primary operative
         D2 source (same role as Asset 2 for 2016).

DATASET: lfst_r_lfsd2pop
TITLE: Population in private households by educational attainment level and NUTS 2 region
SOURCE: Eurostat SDMX-CSV API
URL: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/data/lfst_r_lfsd2pop?format=SDMX-CSV&startPeriod=2014&endPeriod=2014
Downloaded: 2026-05-20
Full download: Data/external/lfst_r_lfsd2pop_2014_full.csv (all countries, 2014; 82,159 lines)
Filtered to: France metropolitan NUTS-2 codes (22 regions), unit=THS_PER, freq=A, TIME_PERIOD=2014
Saved as: Data/external/lfst_r_lfsd2pop_FR_2014.tsv (4,058 data rows + 1 header)
Schema: identical to Asset 2 (columns: DATAFLOW, LAST UPDATE, freq, isced11, sex, age, unit,
        geo, TIME_PERIOD, OBS_VALUE, OBS_FLAG, CONF_STATUS; tab-separated)
NUTS vintage: NUTS-2016 codes confirmed (FR10, FRB0, FRC1, ... FRM0 - same 22 as 2016 reference)

AGE BANDS AVAILABLE:
  Y15-24, Y25-34, Y35-44, Y45-54, Y55-64, Y15-74, Y20-64, Y15-64, Y25-64,
  Y_GE15, Y_GE25, Y_GE65. All required narrow bands and Y20-64 operative band present.

NARROW-BAND SUPPRESSION (OBS_FLAG=u, Y20-64, usable education cells ED0-2/ED3_4/ED5-8, sex M/F):
  Y20-64 rows: 330 total, 74 suppressed (22.4%), 11 with empty OBS_VALUE.
  FRM0: ED0-2, ED3_4, ED5-8 all flagged u for all sex x isced cells (same as 2016).
  NRP category flagged u across most regions - year-invariant suppression pattern.
  FRM0: most heavily suppressed (179 cells across all age bands flagged u).
  FRI2: second-most suppressed (53 cells) - Limousin, small region, same as 2016.
  Construction impact: same D3/approximate_uniform fallback applies for FRM0 and FRI2
  narrow-age ED cells as in 2016.

---
